t: The Sylvania Toledo B22 GLS LED Light Bulb is a frosted, energy-efficient lighting solution designed for general purpose illumination. Provides instant light with uniform distribution, making it an ideal upgrade and replacement for older halogen, incandescent, and compact fluorescent lamps in various settings such as homes, workshops, and commercial spaces across the UK. With good colour rendering (CRI 80) and an average rated life of 15,000 hours, it ensures reliable, long-lasting performance for daily lighting needs. Its compact and elegant design fits seamlessly into existing light fixtures.
